observations: Flagged numbers are overwhelmingly internal analysis outputs (27/40 results, 11/40 author-chosen design params); zero external citations and zero genuinely orphaned figures in this sample. Every record has para_has_any_anchor=false yet 39/40 carry a doc-level task ref and most carry pipeline/frontmatter provenance, so the lint's paragraph-local scope is the dominant false-positive driver. Statistics (p/CI/z/effect-size), counts, and sample-sizes account for ~32/40 and are traceable to the doc's pipeline or a frontmatter pre-registration. None are handwavy. Redesign should (a) resolve provenance at doc/frontmatter scope, not paragraph scope; (b) whitelist statistic/count/param patterns emitted by pipeline-backed entities; (c) skip structural identifiers (task numbers, plan versions like 1.5, ID slash-pairs).
